violations.title: RTE TCS Food, Disposition
violations.observation: Observed the following ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food being held for more than the specified time/temperature allowed: milk expired June 17th
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be discarded if it: 1) exceeds 7 days or at 41F (except the time it is frozen); or 2) is in a container or package that does not bear a date or day. PIC DISCARDED MILK.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature.
